title: reg_jacobian
description: Tool to compute the Jacobian determinant map from a deformation field or control point lattice.

deformation_field.description: Filename of the deformation field (from reg_transform)
deformation_field.title: Deformation Field

control_point_lattice.description: Filename of the control point position lattice (from reg_f3d)
control_point_lattice.title: Control Point Lattice

output_jacobian.description: Filename of the Jacobian determinant map
output_jacobian.title: Jacobian Determinant Map

output_jacobian_matrix.description: Filename of the Jacobian matrix map (9 or 4 values stored as a 5D nifti)
output_jacobian_matrix.title: Jacobian Matrix Map

output_log_jacobian.description: Filename of the Log of the Jacobian determinant map
output_log_jacobian.title: Log of the Jacobian Determinant Map

affine_matrix.description: Filename of the affine matrix to modulate the Jacobian determinant map
affine_matrix.title: Affine Matrix
